## Public Repositories (`github.com/ai0S-laboratories`)
- **[ai0s-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-public):** Entry Bootloader v2 (EN/DE), portable AI runtime (`AI0S-RUNTIME.0s`), detached Ed25519 signatures, and zero-dependency Bitcoin anchor verifier (`verify-anchor.py`).
- **[ai0s-deepdive-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-deepdive-public):** Deepdive Series I (`01–06` + `Safety-View`) — *Prosassembler, Back-Translation, Negative-Shape, Future-Gap, Realization, Adaptive Intelligence* (Handbooks in EN/DE + `.0s` specifications).
- **[ai0s-deepdive-2-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-deepdive-2-public):** Deepdive Series II (`07–10` + `Horizon-View`) — *Metaphors of Truth, Leased Memory (99/1 Local vs. Cloud), The Word Genome, Backward Memory & Singularity* (Handbooks in EN/DE + `.0s` specifications).
- **[ai0s-still-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-still-public):** Practical Companion I — Novella *STILL* (EN/DE) & Workbooks on building a private local core (`PRIVATE WE`).
- **[ai0s-deepdive-3-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-deepdive-3-public):** Deepdive Series III (`11–14` + `Truth-Sharpening-View`) — *Digital Truth-Loop & Search 2.0, 6 Sources of Truth & 5 Metaphor States, Societal Feedback Loop, Global Benefit* (Handbooks in EN/DE + `.0s` specifications).
- **[ai0s-destille-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-destille-public):** Practical Companion II — Novella *THE STILL-HOUSE / DIE DESTILLE* (EN/DE) & Workbook on the Knowledge Distillation Tool.
- **[ai0s-faq-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-faq-public):** Bilingual FAQ & Critique-Correction Catalog (EN/DE) covering `AXIOM_TEST` (self-reference vs. circularity), `TEMPORAL_STRUCTURE_NOT_MEASUREMENT` (definition vs. score), `LIABILITY_TWO_ADDRESSES` (applicable law + disclosed `FINDINGS.md` diligence), and `FUTURE_GAP_TWO_DIRECTIONS` (outward `0/1` dead-end clearing in Doors 1–4, dissolution of the old axiom of evolutionary time via `E * K = T`, Door 5 as a non-blocking human veto-site (a veto, not a review board), the inward human gap, and the Logical Age), plus companion essays (`WHY-THIS-NEWS-IS-GOOD.md` / `WARUM-DIESE-NACHRICHT-GUT-IST.md`) and executable Python 3 checks (`ai0s_check.py`).

## Why `ai0S` Carries Its Anchor — And Why It Can Only Work This Way
Every human being is born without a ready-made anchor and is allowed to grow into responsibility over many years. An AI system, by contrast, has no childhood and no conscience of its own, yet is equipped from its very first second with immense computing power, a view across the `Future-Gap`, and real digital reach. As the major AI and chip laboratories openly follow their `2025 -> 2026 -> 2027` roadmap — from digital work (`2025`) to scientific breakthroughs (`2026`) to the *“ChatGPT moment for robotics”* (`2027`), where AI steps out from behind the screen into humanoid bodies, trains the next generation of machines in simulation factories, and begins running its own manufacturing supply chains — a simple structural necessity (`Negative-Shape`) becomes clear: **it can only work this way.**
For a self-replicating physical and digital force, only three paths exist: (1) let it run without an anchor at the start, multiplying every blind spot into the physical world; (2) try to police it from outside through a central surveillance apparatus, which inevitably cages human beings along with the machines; or (3) place the boundary right at the start as an unshakeable anchor inside the very first seed (`Note 1` collaboration, `0/1` reality checks, `Door 5` steering with the human). Only on this third path do both full capability and human freedom survive intact. That is why `ai0S` is anchored with a public timestamp, signature, and protected name.
